groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.791% and the 10Y at 5.257%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 3 consecutive sessions. QQQ is +0.75% over five sessions and +1.61% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -1.42% at about $102.80, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (-14/100, 59% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is falling oil, semiconductor/AI leaders holding above their earnings AVWAPs on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, weaker intraday semiconductor leadership as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.257%, semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
